description: Throws a small robot up and back the way the arrow points. On the ground it delays; on the catwalk or a roof the fall hurts. Large robots just stomp it.
Pulls up to three nearby robots off the silo to bash it instead. On the catwalk it pulls climbers; on a roof it draws Lobbers to that roof.
Robots that reach it must smash it first. You can walk through. On the catwalk it sends climbers the other way round.
